description: Fully synthetic GraphRAG-PN02 per-notebook isolation & QA corpus. Three isolated notebooks (NB_A Helix Robotics, NB_B Marisol Seaport, NB_C Verdant Agritech), 21 canonical Sources (18 notebook-unique A1-A6/B1-B6/C1-C6 + 3 shared SH_AB/SH_AC/SH_BC), 24 membership edges. Deliberate cross-notebook lexical/entity collisions (the entity 'Project Orion' appears in all three notebooks with a DIFFERENT internal code per notebook: AX-17 in A, BX-94 in B, CX-51 in C) so leakage is observable. Symmetric negatives form a cycle (A asks a B-only fact, B asks a C-only fact, C asks an A-only fact). No real organizations, people, products, or data. Source text contains no query ids, class labels, or answer hints beyond the natural synthetic facts.
